# SCHLÜSSELMACHER24 Architecture Blueprint

This document contains the core architectural blueprint and routing schema for SCHLÜSSELMACHER24.

## DNA Summary
- Framework: Next.js 16+
- React Version: 19.2+
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (OKLCH)
- Brand Color Primary: oklch(0.52 0.24 260)
- Typography: Swiss Modernist

## Transformation Strategy
- Strict Zero-New-Routes policy.
- All modifications are in-place expansions of existing paths.
- Enforcing High-End Swiss Light Mode aesthetic with OKLCH color space.

## Reference
Refer to `.jules/revolution-plan.json` for detailed, route-by-route transformation parameters and `.jules/architecture-matrix.md` for a tabular overview of target word counts and interactive modules.
